slides.text: Claude Code can now <accent>build its own skills.</accent> Create, test, benchmark, and improve Agent Skills <accent>without writing code.</accent> Teach it once. <accent>Use it forever.</accent>

slides.heading: What Are <accent>Skills?</accent>
slides.caption: Reusable muscle memory that makes Claude Code smarter. Code Review, Doc Generator, Test Writer and more.

slides.heading: Before vs <accent>With</accent> Skill Creator
before: No way to test if it works
after: Describe what you want in English

slides.heading: The <accent>4 Modes</accent>
slides.caption: Create, Eval, Benchmark, and Improve. A complete lifecycle for building skills.

slides.heading: How It <accent>Works</accent>
slides.caption: Describe what you need. Skill Creator writes SKILL.md, generates eval cases, runs them, and verifies.

slides.heading: Continuous <accent>Improvement</accent> Loop
slides.caption: Create → Eval → Benchmark → Improve. A self-improving cycle that makes your skills better over time.

slides.heading: Multi-Agent <accent>Benchmarking</accent>
slides.caption: Skill Creator spawns parallel agents to run evals, aggregate results, and compare skill versions.

slides.heading: What Can You <accent>Build?</accent>
slides.caption: Security Reviewer, API Doc Generator, Commit Writer, Test Generator, Post Writer, PR Reviewer and more.

slides.heading: Get It in <accent>30 Seconds</accent>
slides.body:
- Search 'skill-creator' in Extensions
- Or copy from GitHub
- Paste into .claude/skills/
- Type /skill-creator to start

slides.text: The best AI tools don't just follow instructions. They learn to get better at following them. Skill Creator brings that loop to Claude Code.
